children: Cross Ocean Partners Management LP disclosed a 21.3% stake in KLX Energy Services Holdings, Inc. common stock. The position reflects shares acquired through a rights offering and a backstop exchange completed on September 29, 2026. The investment gives the firm the right to appoint a director and signals plans to engage on strategy and governance.

Because Cross Ocean and its affiliates own more than 10% of KLX Energy, they secured "the right to designate a Designated Director" to the board and have already named an independent candidate. The investors plan to engage with management and directors on operations, costs, capital structure, strategy, and board composition, and each backstop party faced a 30% ownership cap in the deal.

Cross Ocean may also "monetize their securities" through tools like derivatives or by pledging shares for liquidity. They left the door open to further negotiations that could change governance or capital structure, while stating they have no fixed plan today.

Cross Ocean Partners Management LP is a Delaware limited partnership that manages funds investing in securities and other assets. The firm focuses on credit and special situations, often using debt and equity to drive value and negotiate outcomes. Based in Greenwich, Connecticut, it is part of a platform overseen by Graham C. Goldsmith through affiliated general partners and managers.
